mapper.select: SELECT tenant_id,operation_id,subject_id,operation_name,idempotency_key,request_sha256,state,http_status,response_ref, target_id,error_code,schema_version,schema_manifest_sha256,created_by,created_at,classification,revision,updated_at, dedup_expires_at,dedup_policy_revision FROM operation_record o WHERE subject_id=#{userId} AND operation_name='DC-02' AND idempotency_key=#{key} FOR UPDATE

SELECT s.upload_id FROM object_upload_session s JOIN artifact_upload_grant g ON g.tenant_id=s.tenant_id AND g.project_key=s.project_key AND g.grant_id=s.grant_id JOIN artifact_upload_binding b ON b.tenant_id=s.tenant_id AND b.upload_id=s.upload_id WHERE s.project_id=#{projectId} AND s.subject_id=#{userId} AND s.purpose='DOCUMENT_BODY' AND s.state='COMPLETED' AND g.status='COMPLETED' AND g.artifact_id=#{input.bodyArtifactId} AND b.document_id=#{documentId} AND b.subject_id=#{userId} AND b.expected_revision=#{input.expectedRevision} FOR UPDATE

SELECT s.section_id AS sectionId,n.node_id AS nodeId FROM plan_section s JOIN plan_section_node n ON n.tenant_id=s.tenant_id AND n.project_id=s.project_id AND n.plan_revision=s.plan_revision AND n.section_id=s.section_id WHERE s.project_id=#{projectId} AND s.plan_revision=#{basis.plan.planRevision} ORDER BY s.section_id,n.position FOR UPDATE
SELECT content_json FROM plan_content_revision p WHERE project_id=#{projectId} AND plan_revision=#{basis.plan.planRevision} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE check_run c SET invalidation_reason='DOCUMENT_REVISION_CHANGED',revision=revision+1,updated_at=#{now} WHERE project_id=#{projectId} AND document_id=#{documentId} AND document_revision=#{input.baseRevision} AND invalidation_reason IS NULL

UPDATE evidence_review_decision e SET validity='INVALIDATED',invalidation_reason='DOCUMENT_REVISION_CHANGED',revision=revision+1,updated_at=#{now} WHERE project_id=#{projectId} AND document_revision=#{input.baseRevision} AND validity='VALID'
mapper.select: SELECT node_id AS nodeId,parent_id AS parentId,ordinal,node_kind AS kind,node_sha256 AS sha256 FROM document_node n WHERE project_id=#{projectId} AND document_revision=#{documentRevision} ORDER BY node_id FOR UPDATE

SELECT field_id AS fieldId,node_id AS nodeId,field_definition_id AS definitionId,value_json AS valueJson FROM field_value f WHERE project_id=#{projectId} AND document_revision=#{documentRevision} ORDER BY field_id FOR UPDATE

SELECT link_id AS linkId,node_id AS nodeId,evidence_id AS evidenceId,claim_id AS claimId,value_json AS valueJson FROM document_evidence_projection e WHERE project_id=#{projectId} AND document_revision=#{documentRevision} ORDER BY link_id,node_id FOR UPDATE

SELECT fact_version AS factId,node_id AS nodeId,field_id AS fieldId FROM fact_usage f WHERE project_id=#{projectId} AND document_revision=#{documentRevision} ORDER BY fact_version,node_id,field_id FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE document_revision_state SET issue_watermark=issue_watermark+#{annotationIssues},revision=revision+1,updated_at=#{now} WHERE project_id=#{projectId} AND document_revision=#{documentRevision} AND issue_watermark=0 AND evidence_watermark=0
